lead: Hoshiar Singh was an Indian military officer, born on 5 May 1937 in Sisana.
He died on 6 December 1998 in Jaipur at the age of 61.
He has been recognised with the Param Vir Chakra.
The sections that follow break down Hoshiar Singh's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.
